'''Imperial Diplomatic Shuttle 993''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] which served as a personal shuttle of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]].<ref name="AotE:HT5" />
